title: Assessing the Role of Statins as an Adjunctive Anti-VEGF Therapy for Clinically Significant Macular Edema (CSME) in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
condition: Type 2 diabetes with NPDR and clinically significant macular edema (ETDRS), 18 patients; prospective randomized interventional study, PGIMER Chandigarh (CTRI REF/2020/06/034527); eligibility admitted treatment-naive eyes and eyes treated for CSME at least 3 months before enrolment; no statin in the previous 6 months; vitamin D loading before statin therapy

groups.agent: ranibizumab 0.5 mg intravitreal plus oral atorvastatin 10-20 mg
groups.description: Group A (randomized): low-dose atorvastatin; three monthly ranibizumab loading injections then PRN to 6 months

groups.agent: ranibizumab 0.5 mg intravitreal plus oral atorvastatin 30-40 mg
groups.description: Group B (randomized): high-dose atorvastatin; three monthly ranibizumab loading injections then PRN to 6 months

series.notes: Mean +/- SD (Statistical analysis); scheduled visits '3 months (10-14 weeks)' and '6 months (22-26 weeks)' recorded at their nominal times; n reported as patients per group (number of eyes not stated); per-visit n not reported

Mean +/- SD; scheduled visits '3 months (10-14 weeks)' and '6 months (22-26 weeks)' recorded at their nominal times; n reported as patients per group (number of eyes not stated); per-visit n not reported

exclusions.reason: Same eyes and visits as Table 4 (duplicate); Table 4 cited

exclusions.what: Table 3/Table 4 BCVA rows, Table 2 IOP and metabolic rows, serum VEGF
p-values (Tables 3 and 4) and Table 5 Pearson correlations
exclusions.reason: p-values and correlation coefficients are not extracted

notes: Treatment combination: each arm combines intravitreal ranibizumab (anti_vegf) with an oral statin (other); both arms receive the investigational statin adjunct at different doses, so both groups are treated.
Measure: CMT by swept-source OCT (DRI Triton, Topcon) 5-line raster scan without a subfield definition: central_unspecified; device topcon.
Prior treatment mixed: eligibility admitted treatment-naive eyes and eyes previously treated for CSME (at least 3 months earlier); the numbers of each are not reported.
Regimen: three monthly ranibizumab loading injections then PRN over six months (loading_then_prn).
